svg.title: Restart, Summarise or Persist
svg.desc: Context decisions: a chat that has grown long or drifted is summarised and restarted, information needed in every chat is saved to Project knowledge or instructions, earlier conversations are found with chat search or memory, and a sensitive one-off chat uses incognito.
svg.text: Chats are temporary; save what you'll need again where it will be found.
Summarise, then start a new chat
Not saved to history or memory
